title.zh: 生物分类与二歧检索表

clips.send: Plantae. Producers that make food from sunlight. Plants make their own food by photosynthesis using chlorophyll. They cannot move from place to place. Includes nonvascular plants (mosses) and vascular plants (ferns, conifers, flowering plants). Plants: sunlight in, sugar out.
clips.text: Plantae. Producers that make food from sunlight. Plants make their own food by photosynthesis using chlorophyll.. They cannot move from place to place.. Includes nonvascular plants (mosses) and vascular plants (ferns, conifers, flowering plants).. Plants: sunlight in, sugar out.

clips.send: Common mix-up: The species name is not just the second word. “lupus” alone means nothing; the species is “Canis lupus”.
clips.text: Common mix-up: The species name is not just the second word. “lupus” alone means nothing; the species is “Canis lupus”.

clips.send: Class. Mammalia. Classes divide a phylum further. Mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians and bony fish are different classes of chordates.
clips.text: Class. Mammalia. Classes divide a phylum further.. Mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians and bony fish are different classes of chordates.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Not all protists are microscopic: giant kelp can grow more than 30 m long.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Not all protists are microscopic: giant kelp can grow more than 30 m long.

clips.send: All life. Every living thing starts here: about 2 million named species, and millions more not yet named. Each ring below holds fewer organisms that share more traits.
clips.text: All life. . Every living thing starts here: about 2 million named species, and millions more not yet named.. Each ring below holds fewer organisms that share more traits.

clips.send: Family. Canidae. A family contains closely related genera. Example: the dog family (Canidae) and the cat family (Felidae).
clips.text: Family. Canidae. A family contains closely related genera.. Example: the dog family (Canidae) and the cat family (Felidae).

clips.send: Family. Hominidae. A family contains closely related genera. Example: the dog family (Canidae) and the cat family (Felidae).
clips.text: Family. Hominidae. A family contains closely related genera.. Example: the dog family (Canidae) and the cat family (Felidae).

clips.send: Fungi. Decomposers that absorb their food. Fungi cannot make their own food. They release digestive juices and absorb the nutrients. Important decomposers that recycle dead plants and animals. The body is a web of threads called hyphae; a mushroom is only the part that makes spores. Fungi “eat” from the outside in: digest first, then absorb.

clips.send: Animalia. Consumers that eat other organisms. Animals must eat (ingest) other organisms to get energy. Most can move on their own for at least part of their life. About 95 percent of animal species are invertebrates (no backbone). Animals: no cell walls, and they eat their food.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Animals are not only furry creatures: sponges, corals, worms and insects are animals too.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Animals are not only furry creatures: sponges, corals, worms and insects are animals too.

clips.send: Order. Carnivora. Orders split a class using more specific traits, such as teeth, feet or diet. Carnivores, primates and rodents are orders of mammals.
clips.text: Order. Carnivora. Orders split a class using more specific traits, such as teeth, feet or diet.. Carnivores, primates and rodents are orders of mammals.

clips.send: Genus. Canis. A genus holds very closely related species. The genus is the first word of a scientific name and is always capitalized.
clips.text: Genus. Canis. A genus holds very closely related species.. The genus is the first word of a scientific name and is always capitalized.

clips.send: Kingdom. Animalia. Six kingdoms: Eubacteria, Archaebacteria, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia. Kingdoms are based on cell type, number of cells and how the organism gets food.
clips.text: Kingdom. Animalia. Six kingdoms: Eubacteria, Archaebacteria, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia.. Kingdoms are based on cell type, number of cells and how the organism gets food.

clips.send: Archaebacteria. Single cells that love extreme places. Many live where little else can: boiling hot springs, very salty lakes, places with no oxygen. Methanogens live in swamps and even in cows’ stomachs and give off methane gas. Carl Woese showed in 1977 that their DNA is very different from bacteria, so they got their own domain. Archaea equals “ancient” extremists: heat, salt, no oxygen.

clips.send: Order. Primates. Orders split a class using more specific traits, such as teeth, feet or diet. Carnivores, primates and rodents are orders of mammals.

clips.send: Phylum. Chordata. A phylum groups organisms with the same basic body plan. Example: Arthropoda (insects, spiders, crabs) all have jointed legs and an exoskeleton.
clips.text: Phylum. Chordata. A phylum groups organisms with the same basic body plan.. Example: Arthropoda (insects, spiders, crabs) all have jointed legs and an exoskeleton.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Mushrooms are not plants. They have no chlorophyll, and their cell walls are made of chitin, like insect shells.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Mushrooms are not plants. They have no chlorophyll, and their cell walls are made of chitin, like insect shells.

clips.send: Domain. Eukarya. The broadest level. There are 3 domains: Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya. Eukarya equals every organism whose cells have a nucleus.
clips.text: Domain. Eukarya. The broadest level. There are 3 domains: Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya.. Eukarya = every organism whose cells have a nucleus.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Bacteria and archaea look alike under a microscope, but their chemistry and DNA are so different that they are in separate domains.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Bacteria and archaea look alike under a microscope, but their chemistry and DNA are so different that they are in separate domains.

clips.send: Species. Homo sapiens. A species is a group of organisms that can breed together and produce fertile offspring. Its scientific name has two words: Genus + species, like Canis lupus.
clips.text: Species. Homo sapiens. A species is a group of organisms that can breed together and produce fertile offspring.. Its scientific name has two words: Genus + species, like Canis lupus.

clips.send: Genus. Homo. A genus holds very closely related species. The genus is the first word of a scientific name and is always capitalized.
clips.text: Genus. Homo. A genus holds very closely related species.. The genus is the first word of a scientific name and is always capitalized.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Not all bacteria are “germs”. Most bacteria do not make people sick.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Not all bacteria are “germs”. Most bacteria do not make people sick.

clips.send: Eubacteria. Tiny single cells found almost everywhere. Live in soil, water, air and inside your body (trillions in your gut). A few cause disease (strep throat), but most are harmless or helpful: making yogurt, helping digestion, recycling dead matter. No nucleus: the DNA floats freely in the cytoplasm. PRO-karyote: “pro” equals before. These cells came before the nucleus existed.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Archaea are not a kind of bacteria, even though both are prokaryotes. They are as different from bacteria as you are!
clips.text: Common mix-up: Archaea are not a kind of bacteria, even though both are prokaryotes. They are as different from bacteria as you are!

clips.send: Common mix-up: Organisms in the same genus share MORE traits than organisms that only share an order. The lower the shared level, the closer the relationship.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Organisms in the same genus share MORE traits than organisms that only share an order. The lower the shared level, the closer the relationship.

clips.send: Protista. The “everything else” eukaryotes. Eukaryotes that are not plants, animals or fungi: a very mixed group. Most live in water. Some make food like plants (algae, euglena); others hunt like animals (amoeba, paramecium). The protist Plasmodium causes malaria. Protist about “proto” equals first: simple early eukaryotes.

clips.send: Species. Canis lupus. A species is a group of organisms that can breed together and produce fertile offspring. Its scientific name has two words: Genus + species, like Canis lupus.

clips.send: 古细菌界。喜欢极端环境的单细胞生物。许多古菌生活在别的生物难以生存的地方：沸腾的温泉、极咸的湖泊、没有氧气的环境。产甲烷菌生活在沼泽甚至牛的胃里，会释放甲烷气体。1977 年，沃斯发现它们的 DNA 与细菌差别很大，于是它们有了自己的域。古细菌 等于 古老的“极限挑战者”：高温、高盐、无氧。

clips.send: 真菌界。靠吸收获取营养的分解者。真菌不能自己制造食物，它们分泌消化液，再吸收养分。它们是重要的分解者，分解死去的动植物，让物质循环利用。真菌的身体是由菌丝组成的网；蘑菇只是它产生孢子的部分。真菌“先消化、再吸收”，在身体外面消化食物。

clips.send: 域。Eukarya。最大的分类等级，共有 3 个域：细菌域、古菌域和真核生物域。真核生物域 等于 细胞有细胞核的所有生物。

clips.send: 目。Carnivora。目用更具体的特征（如牙齿、足、食性）来划分纲。食肉目、灵长目、啮齿目都是哺乳纲中的目。

clips.send: 动物界。摄食其他生物的消费者。动物必须摄食其他生物来获得能量。大多数动物至少在生命的某个阶段能够自主运动。约 百分之95 的动物物种是无脊椎动物（没有脊椎）。动物：没有细胞壁，靠“吃”获取食物。

clips.send: 界。Animalia。六界：真细菌界、古细菌界、原生生物界、真菌界、植物界和动物界。界的划分依据：细胞类型、细胞数量以及获取食物的方式。

clips.send: 真细菌界。几乎无处不在的微小单细胞。生活在土壤、水、空气中，也生活在你体内（肠道里有数万亿个）。少数会致病（如链球菌咽炎），但大多数无害或有益：制作酸奶、帮助消化、分解死去的生物。没有细胞核：DNA 直接漂浮在细胞质中。原核生物：“原” 等于 原始，还没有真正的细胞核。
clips.text: 真细菌界. 几乎无处不在的微小单细胞. 生活在土壤、水、空气中，也生活在你体内（肠道里有数万亿个）。. 少数会致病（如链球菌咽炎），但大多数无害或有益：制作酸奶、帮助消化、分解死去的生物。. 没有细胞核：DNA 直接漂浮在细胞质中。. 原核生物：“原”= 原始，还没有真正的细胞核。

clips.send: 植物界。利用阳光制造食物的生产者。植物利用叶绿素进行光合作用，自己制造食物。它们不能从一个地方移动到另一个地方。包括无维管植物（苔藓）和维管植物（蕨类、松柏、开花植物）。植物：吸收阳光，制造糖分。
clips.text: 植物界. 利用阳光制造食物的生产者. 植物利用叶绿素进行光合作用，自己制造食物。. 它们不能从一个地方移动到另一个地方。. 包括无维管植物（苔藓）和维管植物（蕨类、松柏、开花植物）。. 植物：吸收阳光，制造糖分。

clips.send: 科。Canidae。科包含亲缘关系很近的几个属。例如犬科和猫科。

clips.send: 纲。Mammalia。纲是对门的进一步划分。哺乳动物、鸟类、爬行动物、两栖动物和硬骨鱼是脊索动物门中的不同纲。

clips.send: 种。Homo sapiens。物种是能够相互交配并产生可育后代的一群生物。它的学名由两个词组成：属名 + 种加词，例如 Canis lupus。

clips.send: 门。Chordata。同一个门的生物具有相同的基本身体结构。例如节肢动物门（昆虫、蜘蛛、螃蟹）都有分节的足和外骨骼。

clips.send: 原生生物界。“其他所有”真核生物。不属于植物、动物或真菌的真核生物，是一个非常混杂的类群。大多数生活在水中。有的像植物一样制造食物（藻类、眼虫），有的像动物一样捕食（变形虫、草履虫）。原生生物疟原虫会引起疟疾。原生生物 约等于 “最原始的”真核生物。
